name: Dark Summoning

features.name: Full-symbol cascades
features.description: Every instance of a winning symbol is removed before new symbols cascade in.

features.name: Multiplier wilds
features.description: Wilds land with 2x up to 100x multipliers.

features.name: Two bonuses
features.description: Rise to Salvation and Trial by Hellfire.

review:
Dark Summoning is a 5x6 Hacksaw slot with 24 lines and a cascade mechanic with a twist: when a win occurs, every symbol of the winning type is marked and removed after the wins are paid, not just the ones in the winning line. New symbols then cascade in for further wins.

Wilds can land with multipliers of 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x or 100x. Blue wilds appear in the base game and the Rise to Salvation bonus, red wilds in Trial by Hellfire, with no functional difference. Unholy scatters that land alongside a win are gathered and stored, building towards the bonus. Hacksaw rates it 4 out of 5 with a 10,666x maximum and a top RTP of 96.36%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 88.28% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
